dnd.picked: Picked up draggable item {{id}}. Press arrow keys to move, space to drop.
dnd.movedOver: Draggable item {{id}} was moved over droppable area {{over}}.
dnd.noLongerOver: Draggable item {{id}} is no longer over a droppable area.
dnd.dropped: Draggable item {{id}} was dropped over droppable area {{over}}.
dnd.cancelled: Dragging was cancelled. Draggable item {{id}} was dropped.

placement.moved: Moved on your Garmin calendar to {{date}}
placement.unchanged: Already on your Garmin calendar on {{date}}
placement.duplicateLeft: On your Garmin calendar on {{date}}, but an older entry is still on {{dates}}. Remove it in Garmin Connect.
placement.uncertain: Garmin did not confirm the entry on {{date}}. Check your Garmin calendar before sending again.
placement.checking: Still checking Garmin. You can answer in {{seconds}} s.

libraryOnly.insecure-context: In your Garmin library, with no date: placing it on the calendar needs a secure (https) page.
libraryOnly.bridge-outdated: In your Garmin library, with no date: update the Kaiord Garmin Bridge extension to place it on the calendar.

failed.busy: This workout is already being sent. Try again once that send ends.
failed.settling: Garmin is still processing the last send. Try again in a minute.
failed.record-deleted: This workout was deleted while it was being sent.
failed.guard-failed: The workout changed while it was being sent. Try again.
failed.library-missing: The workout is no longer in your Garmin library. Send it again to re-create it.
failed.library-id-unknown: Garmin did not return the workout's id. Send it again.
failed.schedule-endpoint: Garmin's calendar did not accept the workout.
failed.schedule-rejected: Garmin rejected this date for the workout.
failed.needs-reauth: Sign in to Garmin Connect again, then retry.
failed.deadline-before-send: The extension timed out before sending. Try again.
failed.library-push-failed: The workout could not be sent to Garmin.
failed.no-export-route: Sending workouts to Garmin is turned off. Turn it on in Settings.
failed.placement-interrupted: In your Garmin library, but placing it on its date was interrupted. Send it again to finish.
